note.question: How should mass customization and the “parts-procurement planning problem” be coordinated?
note.overview: This paper studies a new parts-procurement planning problem that is motivated by a global auto manufacturer (GAM) that practices mass customization. Because of the astronomically large number of producible configurations, forecasting their demand is impossible. Instead, firms forecast demand for options that constitute a vehicle.
